project.description: 150 kW rooftop system on a warehouse in Windsor, Ontario

fields.name: licence_held_by_bidder
fields.ask: Does the bidding company itself hold an Ontario electrical contractor licence? Answer 'no' if the electrical work is given to a subcontractor instead, and 'unclear' if the proposal does not say who holds it.

fields.name: licence_number
fields.ask: The licence number exactly as written, if given.

fields.name: wsib_clearance
fields.ask: Does the proposal confirm current WSIB clearance for the bidder?

fields.name: liability_insurance_cad
fields.ask: Amount of liability insurance in CAD, as a plain number (for example $5M = 5000000).

fields.name: qualifying_installs
fields.ask: Number of completed commercial solar installations of 100 kW or more that the bidder says it delivered. Use the number exactly as stated; do not estimate.

fields.name: experience_earliest_year
fields.ask: The earliest calendar year the experience claim covers, only if the proposal gives a year (for example 'since 2020' = 2020). Use not_stated if it only says 'in the last N years'.

fields.name: experience_period_text
fields.ask: The time period of the experience claim, copied as written (for example 'in the past four years').

fields.name: total_price_cad
fields.ask: Total proposed price in CAD as a plain number.

fields.name: price_inclusions
fields.ask: What the proposal says the price includes or excludes (for example permits, utility connection, taxes). Use not_stated if nothing is said.

fields.name: completion_weeks
fields.ask: Committed completion time in weeks from award. Use not_stated if the proposal gives no firm number or says the schedule will be decided later.

fields.name: panel_warranty_years
fields.ask: Length of the panel warranty in years.

fields.name: workmanship_warranty_years
fields.ask: Length of the workmanship warranty in years.

fields.name: named_lead
fields.ask: Does the proposal commit a specific, named or identified project lead now? Answer false if the lead will only be assigned later.

fields.name: crew_stated
fields.ask: Does the proposal state the crew (for example its size or make-up)?

fields.name: safety_plan
fields.ask: Does the proposal include or commit to a site safety plan?

fields.name: monitoring_plan
fields.ask: Does the proposal include ongoing system performance monitoring after installation? Progress reports during construction do not count.
